name: MD Lab VR
description: Build and run a molecular-dynamics simulation in virtual reality. Pick neon, argon, krypton or xenon, or real materials: benzene, graphene, graphite (with van der Waals), MoS₂ and a nanodiamond. Heat, squeeze, and pull atoms or whole layers with controller tweezers while temperature, energy, pair distances and diffusion update live. Twelve guided lab tasks (melting, diffusion, Boyle's law, condensation, peeling graphite, MoS₂ layers, nanodiamond…). Runs on a Meta Quest headset – standalone in the Quest browser, or on a PC through SteamVR/OpenXR – and on the desktop with a mouse.
